brief.task: Choose a short onboarding line for the optional Masterwork mode. The first-time player already knows match-three; double-rimmed cells have two layers of frost. An ordinary match clears one layer; a four-in-line sweep removes both. The text must teach both the visual cue and strategic alternative, fit a single short status line or two lines on a phone, and avoid promising four matching on each target cell.

options.material: Double rims mark two layers. A line sweep breaks both.
options.controls: Tap a pane or swipe a neighbouring colour.
options.economy: You can undo your previous exchange once per chapter.

decision.reason: It is the only option that explains both the visual double-rim cue and the line sweep mechanic for clearing both layers within a concise status line.
